This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.0007/2023 dated 25.01.2023 registered at Police Station-Sidhi, Mahila Police Station, District-Sidhi (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 376(2)(n) & 506 of the IPC.
Applicant is in jail since 26.01.2023.
The allegation against the applicant is that on 20.01.2023, he took the prosecutrix to Sidhi forcibly and outraged her modesty.
Again on 23.01.2023, the applicant forced her to marry with him by giving threatening of dire consequences.
Thereafter, prosecutrix alongwith her husband lodged a complaint in the concerned police station against the applicant for the aforesaid offences.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He has not committed any crime.

The age of prosecutrix is 22 years whereas applicant is 21 years Mustaq All vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148497259/
1 old.

sentences.text: She is a consenting party.
Upon the pressure of her husband and other family members, she lodged complaint against the applicant.
The affidavit regarding compromise has been filed before the learned trial Court.
Charge-sheet has already been filed.
Trial will take sufficient time in its conclusion.
There is no probability of applicant's absconding or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
If he is kept in custody for an unlimited period then his future will become spoiled.
On these grounds, learned counsel for the applicant prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per-contra, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State opposes the bail application.

After hearing arguments of the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as also the facts that he is in jail since 26.01.2023, charge sheet has been filed, trial will take time to conclude, there is no probability of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution evidence,
therefore, without commenting on merits of the case, application of the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. seems to be acceptable.
Consequently, it is hereby allowed.

It is directed that applicant-Mustaq Ali b e released on bail on his furnishing a personal bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the same like amount to the satisfaction of the learned JMFC concerned or trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is directed that the applicant-Mustaq Ali shall be released on bail subject to furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before it on the dates given by the concerned Court.
This order w i l l remain operative subject to compliance of the conditions enumerated under section 437(3) Cr.P.C. by the applicant.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) V. JUDGE Pallavi Mustaq All vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148497259/
